timezoneIdentity.oracle: ICU4J 79.1 TimeZone.getIanaID; only current available IANA IDs intersected, exact availability count asserted.
timezoneIdentity.rust: Allocation-free case-insensitive identity lookup and NamedTimeZone with real IANA TransitionZone providers in tests. Production transition registry loading pending.

plainRelative.calendar: All 16 calendars in native Rust PlainDate/PlainDateTime/ZonedDateTime through sealed arithmetic/borrowed-table providers. Short dates remain ISO; native JS bindings pending.
plainRelative.oracle: ICU4J 79.1 proleptic Gregorian Calendar.add and BigDecimal rounding/totals; eight anchors including BCE/year zero, leap/month ends and years -270000/+275000.
plainRelative.rust: PlainDate total_duration/round_duration/compare_durations and until/since; PlainDateTime calendar-unit until/since. DateTimeUnit retains ZonedUnit alias and TimeUnit argument conversions.
plainRelative.range: Input endpoint includes clock carry and must fit plain-date bounds. Zero values keep date-limit early returns; rounded durations may extend beyond date limits.
plainRelative.note: Native numerical ports and independent oracles supplement TS Test262; complete native Hermes conformance/bindings still required.

arithmeticCalendars.scope: 13 shared numeric engines and public TS date/date-time/short-date/zoned integration. Native public plain date/date-time and zoned classes now use these providers; table providers are recorded separately. Native short dates remain ISO.

oracleLimits.hebrew: Epoch days -1000000 through 1000000. Full-range proleptic invariants checked separately.
oracleLimits.persian: Arithmetic years 1206 through 1498. Existing 33-year approximation outside official range.
oracleLimits.lengthsAndClamping: Derived from ICU forward fields and searched year/month boundaries; avoids negative Coptic/Ethiopic month-length and reverse Indian-setting defects.
oracleLimits.japanese: Era names normalized to Temporal era/monthCode rules; Gregorian eras before 1873.
oracleLimits.differences: Independent forward ICU fields and boundary walks with unregulated month/day comparisons. Does not assume constrained addition and differences are inverses.

publicCalendars.strictScope: Current combined calendar gate covers named families across all 16 calendars and rare Chinese/Dangi MonthDay controls. Oracle counts in this object cover the arithmetic subset; table controls are recorded separately.

nativeControls.note: Older hand-written native expectations corrected against pinned native runtime and specification.

strictGatesPerMode.scope: Distinct union of strict built-in classes, Now, installation, named-calendar, historical timezone-edge and owned locale/enumeration gates. Full diagnostics remain separate; no complete conformance claim.

tableCalendars.nativeRust: Allocation-free validated borrowed packs; shared arithmetic trait. Public native PlainDate/PlainDateTime/ZonedDateTime accept table providers; native short dates remain ISO.
tableCalendars.source: Pinned ICU4X generated calendar packs, now indexed by day and month checkpoints every 64 years. No runtime Intl lookup.

hko.directControls: All month starts, lengths and next-month additions in TS/Rust.

kasi.boundary: 2017-02-26 at 23:58 KST starts Dangi M02; ICU79 is one day late.
kasi.regression: 2017-06-24 starts leap month 5. Runtime ICU4X pack already matches both published facts.

tableCalendars.oracle: ICU4J 79.1 forward conversion and searched boundaries; Chinese complete years 1901..2099 use published HKO fields; Dangi February 2017 uses KASI. Raw ICU comparison stays unfiltered and failing.

rawIcuDiagnostic.status: Manual failing diagnostic, unfiltered; published authority controls explain oracle discrepancies. No accepted-failure baseline.

zonedEdges.offsetPrecision: TS string syntax distinguishes minute matching from exact seconds/fractions; bags exact. Rust zoned-string facade still pending.
zonedEdges.calendarDifference: TS/Rust compare wall clocks before gap-compatible calendar anchor resolution.
zonedEdges.nativeRust: ZonedDateTime start_of_day, hours_in_day, round day/clock units; original offset preferred for clock rounding.

icu.source: ICU4J 79.1 proleptic Gregorian styles and requested-width skeletons with locale zone-append patterns. Exact string comparison; no row exclusions or normalization.

nativeCalendarFacades.controls: ICU4J 79.1 arithmetic and mixed ICU/HKO/KASI table fixtures. Public getters, typed field reconstruction, addition, comparison, differences, relative totals and ceil/floor/trunc rounding. No oracle rows excluded.
nativeCalendarFacades.utcZonedScope: Requires representable UTC Instants. Separate +/-12-hour fixed-zone controls cover both extended plain-date limits across all 16 providers.
nativeCalendarFacades.calendarIdentity: Differences reject mismatches for all units. compare orders ISO coordinates; equals also checks calendar ID. Representation may differ between arithmetic and CalendarRef providers.
nativeCalendarFacades.parser: Arithmetic calendar annotations, normalized aliases and explicit borrowed-provider parse_in. Native zoned strings now use the production registry. Short-date parsing canonicalizes calendar reference dates.
nativeCalendarFacades.implementation: Sealed copyable CalendarProvider; CalendarRef unifies 13 arithmetic and three borrowed table engines. No formatter, runtime ICU or allocation dependency. Existing fields() retains ISO coordinates; calendar_fields() supplies calendar values.
nativeCalendarFacades.test262: Native numerical/oracle coverage only. Native Hermes Test262 backend not installed yet.

nativeCalendarShortDates.controls: ICU4J 79.1 forward month catalog and calendar-span BigDecimal rounding, with existing HKO/KASI corrections. YearMonth integration also uses existing field/add/difference fixtures.
nativeCalendarShortDates.bounds: YearMonth reference fields use ISO year/month bounds; required calendar month starts enforce PlainDate bounds. MonthDay conversion retains monthCode across years.
nativeCalendarShortDates.wasm: No new exports; existing primitive size measurements do not cover these public facades/data.
nativeCalendarShortDates.test262: Native numerical coverage; native Hermes Test262 remains pending.

nativeTimeZoneRegistry.utc: Intrinsic, including UTC aliases; available without loaded records.
nativeTimeZoneRegistry.offsets: Minute identifiers normalize separately; negative zero becomes +00:00. Named UTC and offset zero retain distinct identity.
nativeTimeZoneRegistry.controls: Existing ICU4J corpora now use production registry, including aliases. Transition query instants check both directions and adjacent nanoseconds. All recognized IANA names must resolve; ICU-only legacy names absent from the pinned identifier table must reject. Primary record coverage equals independent ICU identity profile.
nativeTimeZoneRegistry.data: Caller-owned borrowed records or Bazel-generated static all-zone pack via compiled_time_zones. Checked const constructors validate transitions and footer rules. No runtime allocation, JSON, serde or formatter dependency. Default core/WASM excludes the pack.

nativeZonedStrings.offsets: UTC, wall, exact and minute-precision hints; reject/prefer/use/ignore; exact matching for explicit seconds, historical rounding for minute strings.
nativeZonedStrings.annotations: ISO grammar, calendar aliases/critical/duplicate rules, explicit borrowed calendar providers across all 16 calendars. Default FromStr uses the 13 arithmetic calendars and optional compiled timezone pack.
nativeZonedStrings.formatting: Rounds instant before querying offset; precision, offset visibility, zone critical/visibility and calendar annotations.
nativeZonedStrings.test262: Pinned native numerical/string regression vectors; native Hermes backend still absent.
